# Spotless Deck Staining

Premium deck and fence staining serving Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge and Guelph, Ontario.

## Services
- Deck Staining — two-coat penetrating premium stains (Sherwin-Williams SuperDeck, Sansin, Sikkens)
- Fence Staining — UV + moisture protection for cedar, pine, pressure-treated wood
- Sealing & Protection — clear or tinted protective sealers, recommended every 2-3 seasons
- Power Washing & Prep — eco-friendly wood-safe cleaners, correct PSI per wood type
- Deck Restoration — assessment, board replacement, sanding, brightening, refinishing

## Service Area
Kitchener (Downtown, Forest Heights, Doon, Stanley Park, Victoria Park),
Waterloo (Uptown, Beechwood, Lakeshore, Laurelwood, Westmount),
Cambridge (Galt, Preston, Hespeler, Blair, West Galt),
Guelph (Old University, Exhibition Park, Kortright Hills, Westminster Woods)
and surrounding KW / Waterloo Region.

## About
Local, family-run, fully insured KW-based crew. Same team starts and finishes every project —
no subcontractors. Written 2-year workmanship warranty on every job. Low-VOC, eco-friendly
stains safe for kids, pets and the Grand River watershed once cured.
